author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
It's used more heavily than GitHub and Facebook in terms of users here... and why not have us all share our on fire mixtapes? Why not let us impress our fam? Why not give us the aux cord?

Soundcloud is a really cool thing though. We should have it, I'd love to check out tunes or whatever you guys have.
